en.text: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

zhSimplified.text: 申初祷告的时候，彼得、约翰上圣殿去。

zhTraditional.text: 申初禱告的時候，彼得、約翰上聖殿去。

en.text: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

zhSimplified.text: 有一个人，生来是瘸腿的，天天被人抬来，放在殿的一个门口（那门名叫美门），要求进殿的人周济。

zhTraditional.text: 有一個人，生來是瘸腿的，天天被人抬來，放在殿的一個門口（那門名叫美門），要求進殿的人賙濟。

en.text: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

zhSimplified.text: 他看见彼得、约翰将要进殿，就求他们周济。

zhTraditional.text: 他看見彼得、約翰將要進殿，就求他們賙濟。

en.text: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”

zhSimplified.text: 彼得、约翰定睛看他；彼得说：「你看我们！」

zhTraditional.text: 彼得、約翰定睛看他；彼得說：「你看我們！」

en.text: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

zhSimplified.text: 那人就留意看他们，指望得着什么。

zhTraditional.text: 那人就留意看他們，指望得着甚麼。

en.text: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

zhSimplified.text: 彼得说：「金银我都没有，只把我所有的给你：我奉拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名，叫你起来行走！」

zhTraditional.text: 彼得說：「金銀我都沒有，只把我所有的給你：我奉拿撒勒人耶穌基督的名，叫你起來行走！」

en.text: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

zhSimplified.text: 于是拉着他的右手，扶他起来；他的脚和踝子骨立刻健壮了，

zhTraditional.text: 於是拉着他的右手，扶他起來；他的腳和踝子骨立刻健壯了，

en.text: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

zhSimplified.text: 就跳起来，站着，又行走，同他们进了殿，走着，跳着，赞美 神。

zhTraditional.text: 就跳起來，站着，又行走，同他們進了殿，走着，跳着，讚美上帝。

en.text: All the people saw him walking and praising God.

zhSimplified.text: 百姓都看见他行走，赞美 神；

zhTraditional.text: 百姓都看見他行走，讚美上帝；

en.text: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

zhSimplified.text: 认得他是那素常坐在殿的美门口求周济的，就因他所遇着的事满心希奇、惊讶。

zhTraditional.text: 認得他是那素常坐在殿的美門口求賙濟的，就因他所遇着的事滿心希奇、驚訝。

en.text: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

zhSimplified.text: 那人正在称为所罗门的廊下，拉着彼得、约翰；众百姓一齐跑到他们那里，很觉希奇。

zhTraditional.text: 那人正在稱為所羅門的廊下，拉着彼得、約翰；眾百姓一齊跑到他們那裏，很覺希奇。

en.text: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

zhSimplified.text: 彼得看见，就对百姓说：「以色列人哪，为什么把这事当作希奇呢？为什么定睛看我们，以为我们凭自己的能力和虔诚使这人行走呢？

zhTraditional.text: 彼得看見，就對百姓說：「以色列人哪，為甚麼把這事當作希奇呢？為甚麼定睛看我們，以為我們憑自己的能力和虔誠使這人行走呢？

en.text: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

zhSimplified.text: 亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的 神，就是我们列祖的 神，已经荣耀了他的仆人耶稣；你们却把他交付彼拉多。彼拉多定意要释放他，你们竟在彼拉多面前弃绝了他。

zhTraditional.text: 亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的上帝，就是我們列祖的上帝，已經榮耀了他的僕人耶穌；你們卻把他交付彼拉多。彼拉多定意要釋放他，你們竟在彼拉多面前棄絕了他。

en.text: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

zhSimplified.text: 你们弃绝了那圣洁公义者，反求着释放一个凶手给你们。

zhTraditional.text: 你們棄絕了那聖潔公義者，反求着釋放一個兇手給你們。

en.text: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

zhSimplified.text: 你们杀了那生命的主， 神却叫他从死里复活了；我们都是为这事作见证。

zhTraditional.text: 你們殺了那生命的主，上帝卻叫他從死裏復活了；我們都是為這事作見證。

en.text: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

zhSimplified.text: 我们因信他的名，他的名便叫你们所看见所认识的这人健壮了；正是他所赐的信心，叫这人在你们众人面前全然好了。

zhTraditional.text: 我們因信他的名，他的名便叫你們所看見所認識的這人健壯了；正是他所賜的信心，叫這人在你們眾人面前全然好了。

en.text: “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

footnotes.text: 3:17 The word for “brothers” here may be also correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

zhSimplified.text: 弟兄们，我晓得你们做这事是出于不知，你们的官长也是如此。

zhTraditional.text: 弟兄們，我曉得你們做這事是出於不知，你們的官長也是如此。

en.text: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

zhSimplified.text: 但 神曾借众先知的口，预言基督将要受害，就这样应验了。

zhTraditional.text: 但上帝曾藉眾先知的口，預言基督將要受害，就這樣應驗了。

en.text: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,

zhSimplified.text: 所以，你们当悔改归正，使你们的罪得以涂抹，

zhTraditional.text: 所以，你們當悔改歸正，使你們的罪得以塗抹，

en.text: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,

zhSimplified.text: 这样，那安舒的日子就必从主面前来到；主也必差遣所预定给你们的基督（耶稣）降临。

zhTraditional.text: 這樣，那安舒的日子就必從主面前來到；主也必差遣所預定給你們的基督（耶穌）降臨。

en.text: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

zhSimplified.text: 天必留他，等到万物复兴的时候，就是 神从创世以来、借着圣先知的口所说的。

zhTraditional.text: 天必留他，等到萬物復興的時候，就是上帝從創世以來、藉着聖先知的口所說的。

en.text: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西曾说：『主— 神要从你们弟兄中间给你们兴起一位先知像我，凡他向你们所说的，你们都要听从。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西曾說：『主－上帝要從你們弟兄中間給你們興起一位先知像我，凡他向你們所說的，你們都要聽從。

en.text: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’

zhSimplified.text: 凡不听从那先知的，必要从民中全然灭绝。』

zhTraditional.text: 凡不聽從那先知的，必要從民中全然滅絕。』

en.text: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.

zhSimplified.text: 从撒母耳以来的众先知，凡说预言的，也都说到这些日子。

zhTraditional.text: 從撒母耳以來的眾先知，凡說預言的，也都說到這些日子。

en.text: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring.’

zhSimplified.text: 你们是先知的子孙，也承受 神与你们祖宗所立的约，就是对亚伯拉罕说：『地上万族都要因你的后裔得福。』

zhTraditional.text: 你們是先知的子孫，也承受上帝與你們祖宗所立的約，就是對亞伯拉罕說：『地上萬族都要因你的後裔得福。』

en.text: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”

zhSimplified.text: 神既兴起他的仆人，就先差他到你们这里来，赐福给你们，叫你们各人回转，离开罪恶。」

zhTraditional.text: 上帝既興起他的僕人，就先差他到你們這裏來，賜福給你們，叫你們各人回轉，離開罪惡。」
